Chapter 6540: Refine You

Chapter 6540: Refine You

Spectators in Heaven World felt the firmament turning into a maelstrom, seizing the dao and powers of their world before sending them toward Supreme Black Ancestor.

“This is terrible!” An ominous doom took over the minds.

The immensity of the firmament could crush everyone to blood. They felt insignificant, unable to resist regardless of their cultivation, just like an ant trying to push up a foot.

On the other hand, Supreme Black Ancestor remained calm since he had the powers of Three Immortals within his grasp.

As he raised one hand, he conjured a hoof. The world suddenly turned dark and he absorbed this darkness. He finally utilized his true power - his unique dao source.

This darkness was not one of evil, greed, or any other negative affinity. It was pure like the light - a unique dao path available to him alone.

The release of his aura immobilized everyone. However, they found this to be rather beneficial for dao enlightenment.

“Raa!” Nine Secrets only had instinct left at this point and could still use his mystical nine words, sending the firmament to crush the opponent.

“World Flipper.” Black murmured and shot out the dark dao in the form of a horn.

Everyone was flipped into the air while feeling as if the size of the world no longer mattered. As long as it was real, it would be flipped over right now.

“Bam!” This applied to the firmament as well. The worlds within the nine layers crumbled as the dragon hybrid was sent flying.

Black then grasped the opponent with billowing dark energy. It was overwhelming. If he loosened his grip, it would engulf all of Three Immortals. When tightened, the countless strings would strangle and crush everything.

“Ahh!” Nine Secrets roared in pain while his bones shattered.

“Black Cauldron Refinement!” Black placed his palms together and the dark energy transformed into a cauldron, trapping Nine Secrets inside.

Black flames ignited and burned everything inside. Spectators felt that Black could do the same to their world, refining it into the most precious serum.

Nine Secrets bellowed in agony while infusing the nine words into his colossal weapon for a smash. This greatly strengthened the impact as it struck the cauldron’s wall.

“Rumble!” Large bulges appeared on the cauldron’s exterior only to cave back down immediately.

Black had firmly sealed the cauldron while relentlessly unleashing his one-of-a-kind flame.

“Saving you is impossible, I can only deliver you from this hell.” Black murmured.

Everyone could see that although Nine Secrets was still here, he was suffering a fate worse than death.

“Rumble!” The repeated smash shook Heaven World in its entirety. It would be apocalyptic if uncontained.

“So strong.” Spectators were amazed at Black’s power in suppressing the unimaginable monster.

“Pop!” The palace shrouded in flames suddenly opened again, shooting out immortal rays. They were chaotic and frenzied like a swarm of locusts.

Their power was beyond imagination, ready to gnaw Heaven World until nothing remained.

“Black Void Termination!” Black became startled and created a barrier around Heaven World.
